name: Fuente Carreteros (Spain)
description: Divided diagonally from the lower hoist to the upper fly, green above with the crowned municipal arms of Fuente Carreteros (a saint and a cart on white) in the upper hoist and white below with five red stars in the lower fly.
history: Municipal flag of Fuente Carreteros; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Fuente Carreteros arms — saint and cart
